extDescription.message: Hides IDs, e-mails, names, endpoints and secrets in the Microsoft Fabric & Power BI portal – pixelated, blurred, redacted or faked.

popupNotFabric.message: Not a Fabric / Power BI page. After installing or updating the extension, reload open Fabric tabs.

catGuidHint.message: Workspace, item, tenant and capacity IDs

catEndpointHint.message: SQL endpoints, OneLake paths, XMLA, KQL URIs

catSecretHint.message: Account keys, SAS signatures, passwords, JWTs

catUserProfileHint.message: Account menu, avatars, owner and admin names, workspace images

pickElementHint.message: Click any element on the page. Esc cancels.

customTermsHint.message: One per line, case-insensitive. Use for customer, tenant, workspace or person names. Elements containing one of these terms are masked.

customSelectorsHint.message: One per line. Matching elements are always masked. Use the element picker in the popup to add selectors from the page.

resetConfirm.message: Reset all settings, custom terms and selectors?

limitationsText.message: The address bar (which contains workspace and item IDs), native tooltips and content drawn on a canvas (e.g. report visuals) cannot be masked by an extension. Notebooks, the lakehouse explorer and pipelines run in their own frames and are covered as well. Always double-check before sharing your screen.

catWorkspaceNamesHint.message: Header, navigation, workspace list, catalog location

catLearnedNamesHint.message: Names from owner/admin fields, masked everywhere

curtainButtonHint.message: Hides all Fabric tabs behind a neutral overlay (Alt+Shift+B)

curtainHint.message: Fab Mask is hiding this page. Press Alt+Shift+B or use the extension popup to continue.

previewBadge.message: Fab Mask preview · $COUNT$ masked · Alt+Shift+P to exit

profilesHint.message: Save the current appearance and detection settings as a profile and switch between them in the popup. Custom terms and selectors are shared by all profiles.

noProfiles.message: No profiles of your own yet.

learnedNamesHint.message: Fab Mask collects names from owner and admin fields and masks them everywhere in the portal. Stored only in this browser profile.

learnedNamesEmpty.message: No names learned yet – open a workspace or the OneLake catalog.

menuHideElement.message: Fab Mask: always hide this element

commandPresentation.message: Presentation mode: full screen (hides the address bar) + masking on

presentButtonHint.message: Full screen hides the address bar with workspace and item IDs; masking is turned on (Alt+Shift+F)

presentationHint.message: Alt+Shift+F or "Present" in the popup switches the window to full screen – the address bar with workspace and item IDs disappears from your screen share – and turns masking on. Press it again to return.

sendFeedbackHint.message: Opens a pre-filled GitHub issue (version, browser and mode only – no page URLs, terms or names)

aboutText.message: Creator of Fab Mask and fabricperiodictable.com. Fab Mask is free and open source (MIT).
